_comment: A local clock. The system prompt carries only the date, because a second-precision timestamp there would invalidate the provider's prefix cache on every request. This tool gives exact time on demand, with no network call.

tools.name: current_time
tools.description: 获取服务器当前的精确时间（本地时区与 UTC）。系统提示词里只有日期，需要具体时刻时用这个工具，不要联网去查。

timezone.description: 可选的 IANA 时区名，例如 Asia/Shanghai；留空则用服务器本地时区
